user.title: Connect Mennekes AMTRON Charge Control
user.description: Modbus TCP must already be enabled on the wallbox (Load management menu, logged in as Operator; also enable "free charging" under Authorization so this integration can start sessions - see README).

error.invalid_response: The wallbox replied with a Modbus error: {error_detail}

init.title: Mennekes AMTRON options
init.description: These values are not read back from the wallbox automatically - set them to match your installation.

data_description.phase_mode: Only relevant if your wallbox has phase-switching hardware installed. Leave "Disabled" if unsure - see README.

pv_sources.title: PV surplus: sources
pv_sources.description: Optional. Entities from other integrations (e.g. your inverter) the PV surplus is calculated from: feed-in minus grid import minus battery discharge plus the wallbox's own charging power, averaged over 2 minutes. All values are expected as positive power values (W or kW). Without a feed-in entity nothing is calculated and the "PV surplus" charge mode does nothing.

data_description.pv_feed_in_entities: Several entities are added up, e.g. the inverter's feed-in plus balcony power plants. Don't add a plant whose output your grid meter already includes, or it counts twice.
data_description.pv_grid_import_entity: Counts as 0 W if left empty.
data_description.pv_battery_discharge_entity: Counts as 0 W if left empty (no home battery).
data_description.pv_battery_soc_entity: The "PV surplus" charge mode starts at or above the start SoC and stops below the stop SoC. Leave empty without a home battery.

error.start_current_above_max: The start current cannot be higher than the maximum charging current.
